name: Nekomusume no Kyūsei
source:
You meet the cat demon girl "Suzu" when you go to a merchant's "friend" and he forcibly gives you Suzu, whose origin is unknown, but as certain things progress, you'll gradually find that some people and things are in need of redemption, and the "redemption" of ...... is, in the end, who?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651560]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你去商人的“朋友”处遇到了猫妖少女“素祖”，他强行送给你素祖，来历不明，但随着某些事情的进展，你会逐渐发现，有些人和事需要救赎，而……的“救赎”，到底是谁？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651560]Steam[/url]]
